description: Centrally sync a UFW whitelist (fleet IPs + DDNS home exits) to every agent via admin:exec. Default is check/dry-run; flip the 'apply' switch to enforce.
author: lddcc

help.zh_CN: 关闭时只计算并打印每台的 diff，不改动防火墙。确认 dry-run 无误后再打开。
help.en: When off, only compute and print each node's diff without changing firewalls. Turn on after reviewing the dry-run.

name.zh_CN: 自动放行机队各节点 IP

help.zh_CN: 自动把 Komari 已知的所有节点公网 v4/v6 加入白名单（节点间互信）。
help.en: Add every Komari node's public v4/v6 to the whitelist (fleet cross-trust).

name.zh_CN: 自动同步间隔（分钟，0=关闭）

help.zh_CN: 定时自动同步的间隔分钟数；0 表示关闭定时，只手动执行。改动即时生效，无需重载。
help.en: Minutes between scheduled syncs; 0 disables the schedule (manual only). Takes effect immediately, no reload.

help.zh_CN: 空格/逗号分隔的主机名，各节点本地解析为 A 记录后放行。例：4hz.lddcc.cc 4ny.lddcc.cc
help.en: Space/comma-separated hostnames, resolved locally on each node to A records. e.g. 4hz.lddcc.cc 4ny.lddcc.cc

help.zh_CN: 空格/逗号分隔的主机名，解析后掩为 /64 放行。例：6hz.lddcc.cc 6ny.lddcc.cc
help.en: Space/comma-separated hostnames, resolved then masked to /64. e.g. 6hz.lddcc.cc 6ny.lddcc.cc
Extra fixed v4 addrs/CIDRs, space/comma-separated. e.g. 100.64.0.0/10 10.255.255.0/24

help.zh_CN: 额外固定放行的 v6 地址或网段，空格/逗号分隔。
设置后可用 GET /sync?token=<此值> 手动触发。登录管理员无需 token。留空则禁用匿名手动触发。
help.en: When set, GET /sync?token=<value> triggers manually. Logged-in admins need no token. Empty disables anonymous triggering.
